title: Overview: Zero-Knowledge Proof Authenticators
description: Login systems proving who you are with zero-knowledge cryptography — no passwords or secrets transmitted. Everything digital rides on networks: faster, more secure, more resilient communication underpins the whole economy. This database covers all the pieces needed to make it: core components, materials, processes, software, and subsystems, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Every record is the full entry with definitions, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

title: Signature design: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: Signature design: The working vocabulary of Zero-Knowledge Proof Authenticators: Latency, Throughput, Encryption, Zero trust, Failover, Spectrum, QKD, Mesh.
definition: Glossary for Zero-Knowledge Proof Authenticators.
key_points: Latency: Network delay — critical for real-time applications.
Throughput: Data rate a link actually delivers.
Encryption: Scrambling data so only key holders read it.
Zero trust: Never trust, always verify — no implicit network trust.
Failover: Automatic switch to backup when primary fails.
Spectrum: Radio frequencies — the shared airwaves.
QKD: Quantum key distribution — keys secured by physics.
Mesh: Network where nodes relay for each other, no single hub.
how_it_works: Learn the terms before the details.
Use the demo as a flash drill.
Add your own terms as you learn.
Teach the vocabulary to your team.
